## README.md
# LandMark: Indigenous & Community Land Rights (v202509)

[LandMark](https://landmarkmap.org) provides the world's first global platform to map land rights of Indigenous Peoples and local communities. This collection covers the September 2025 (v202509) release.

**License:** [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
**Citation:** LandMark: The Global Platform of Indigenous and Community Lands (v202509). https://landmarkmap.org
**Source:** https://landmarkmap.org/data-methods/

---

## Datasets

| Layer | Features | Geometry | Formats |
|-------|----------|----------|---------|
| IPLC Polygon | 124,616 | Polygon | GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex |
| IPLC Point | 2,646 | Point | GeoParquet, PMTiles |
| Indicative Polygon | 17,539 | Polygon | GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex |

### IPLC Polygon (`iplc-poly`)
Community-level polygon boundaries aggregated from local, national, and regional mapping initiatives. Each feature represents a documented indigenous or community territory.

```
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-poly.parquet
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-poly.pmtiles
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-poly/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet
```

**PMTiles source-layer:** `iplc-poly`

### IPLC Point (`iplc-pt`)
Point locations (centroids or representative points) for IPLC areas. Useful for overview mapping and tabular joins.

```
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-pt.parquet
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-pt.pmtiles
```

**PMTiles source-layer:** `iplc-pt`

### Indicative Areas Polygon (`indicative-poly`)
Model-estimated indicative extent of indigenous and community lands in areas where direct boundary mapping is unavailable. Derived from population surveys, national statistics, and modeling.

```
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/indicative-poly.parquet
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/indicative-poly.pmtiles
https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/indicative-poly/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet
```

**PMTiles source-layer:** `indicative-poly`

---

## Field Descriptions

All polygon and point layers share the same schema:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `_cng_fid` | int64 | Internal feature ID |
| `OGC_FID` | int64 | Original source feature ID |
| `identity` | string | Identity type (Indigenous Peoples / Local Communities) |
| `name` | string | Name of the community or people |
| `form_rec` | string | Form of recognition of the land right |
| `doc_status` | string | Documentation status |
| `stat_date` | string | Date of status determination |
| `stat_note` | string | Notes on status |
| `country` | string | Country where territory is located |
| `category` | string | Category of land right |
| `ethncty_1` | string | Primary ethnicity/group classification |
| `populatn` | int64 | Population estimate |
| `pop_source` | string | Source of population estimate |
| `pop_year` | int64 | Year of population estimate |
| `area_ofcl` | double | Official recorded area (hectares) |
| `area_gis` | double | GIS-computed area (hectares) |
| `scale` | string | Scale/accuracy of mapped boundary |
| `method` | string | Method used to delineate boundary |
| `data_ctrb` | string | Data contributor organization |
| `data_src` | string | Primary data source name |
| `data_src_s` | string | Data source short name |
| `data_src_l` | string | Data source URL |
| `data_date` | string | Date of source data |
| `add_note` | string | Additional notes |
| `more_info` | string | URL for more information |
| `layer` | string | Source layer name |
| `download` | string | Download URL for source data |
| `iso_code` | string | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (polygon layers) |
| `geom` | geometry | Geometry in WGS84 (OGC:CRS84) |

---

## Usage Examples

### DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- Count IPLC territories by country
SELECT country, COUNT(*) as n_territories, SUM(area_gis) as total_ha
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-poly.parquet')
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY n_territories DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Query H3 hex index at resolution 8
SELECT h0, h3_index, identity, COUNT(*) as n_cells
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-poly/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet',
                  hive_partitioning=true)
WHERE resolution = 8
GROUP BY h0, h3_index, identity
LIMIT 10;
```

### MapLibre GL JS (IPLC Polygon)

```javascript
map.addSource('iplc-poly', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/iplc-poly.pmtiles'
});

map.addLayer({
  id: 'iplc-poly-fill',
  type: 'fill',
  source: 'iplc-poly',
  'source-layer': 'iplc-poly',   // <-- this is the source-layer name
  paint: {
    'fill-color': '#2196f3',
    'fill-opacity': 0.4
  }
});
```

### MapLibre GL JS (Indicative Areas)

```javascript
map.addSource('indicative-poly', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-indigenous/landmark/indicative-poly.pmtiles'
});

map.addLayer({
  id: 'indicative-poly-fill',
  type: 'fill',
  source: 'indicative-poly',
  'source-layer': 'indicative-poly',   // <-- this is the source-layer name
  paint: {
    'fill-color': '#ff9800',
    'fill-opacity': 0.3
  }
});
```

---

## Processing Notes

- Source: LandMark v202509 shapefiles downloaded from https://landmarkmap.org/data-methods/
- Raw source files archived at `s3://public-indigenous/raw/`
- Processed using `cng-datasets` on NRP Nautilus Kubernetes cluster
- H3 hex tiling at resolution 10 with parent resolutions 9, 8, 0
- `indicative-pt` (point layer) processing pending upstream fix for Measured 3D MultiPoint geometry
